parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：10~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the query result. Valid values: positive integers. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果的页码。取值范围：正整数。 默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The instance type. Set the value to Instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例类型，当前固定为 Instance
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Scheduled: Pending execution.

Running: Running.

Succeed: Succeeded.

Failed: Failed.

Cancelling: Being canceled.

Canceled: Canceled.

Waiting: Waiting for the scheduled time.

You can specify multiple values separated by commas (,). If this parameter is left empty, all statuses are queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，取值说明：

Scheduled：等待执行。

Running：执行中。

Succeed：执行成功。

Failed：执行失败。

Cancelling：正在终止。

Canceled：已终止。

Waiting：等待预设时间。

如需查询多个状态则用英文逗号分隔，默认为空，表示全选
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. You can specify multiple cluster IDs separated by commas (,). You can specify up to 30 cluster IDs. If this parameter is left empty, historical tasks of all clusters in the region are queried by default
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。多个集群ID用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多填写30个集群ID。若不填写，则默认查询该地域下所有集群的历史任务
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You can specify multiple task IDs separated by commas (,). You can specify up to 30 task IDs. If this parameter is left empty, historical tasks of all clusters are queried by default
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。多个任务ID用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多填写30个任务ID。若不填写，则默认查询所有集群的历史任务
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The task type. This parameter is used to query tasks of a specific type. You can specify multiple task types separated by commas (,). You can specify up to 30 task types. If this parameter is left empty, no limit is applied
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型，用于查询特定类型任务情况，如有多个用英文逗号（,）分隔，最多支持 30 个，默认为空，表示不限制
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the time range to query task start times. Tasks that start after this time are queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The earliest supported time is 30 days ago. If the specified time is more than 30 days before the current time, it is automatically changed to 30 days ago
parameters.help_zh: 任务开始时间的起始时间，表示查询任务开始时间在此时间之后的任务。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 UTC +0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。最早支持 30 天前，距当前时间超过 30 天会自动转换成 30 天前
parameters.name: from_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the time range to query task start times. Tasks that start before this time are queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 任务开始时间的结束时间，表示查询任务开始时间在此时间之前的任务。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 UTC +0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: to_start_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum execution duration of the task. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is greater than this value. Unit: seconds. Default value: 0, which indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最小值。用于筛选任务执行耗时大于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认 0，表示不限制
parameters.name: from_exec_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum execution duration of the task. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration does not exceed this value. Unit: seconds. Default value: 0, which indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最大值。用于筛选任务执行耗时不小于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认 0，表示不限制
parameters.name: to_exec_time

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial. This field is returned only when RAM authentication fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息；只有Ram校验失败才会返回此字段

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authorization principal

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the authentication principal

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The type of the authorization principal

NoPermissionType.description_en:
The type of the access policy denial. Valid values:
ImplicitDeny: The resource owner has not configured a relevant access policy for the current user, and unauthorized operations are denied by default.
ExplicitDeny: The RAM policy configured by the resource owner explicitly denies the current user from accessing the corresponding resource
NoPermissionType.description_zh:
权限策略拒绝的类型，取值如下：
ImplicitDeny：资源持有者未配置相关权限策略给当前用户，缺省拒绝未授权的操作。
ExplicitDeny：资源持有者配置的RAM策略明确拒绝了当前用户访问对应的资源

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the policy that causes the permission denial. Valid values:
ControlPolicy: Control policy.
SessionPolicy: Session policy, which is an additional permission policy added to a temporary token.
AssumeRolePolicy: Assume role policy, which is the trust policy of a RAM role.
AccountLevelIdentityBasedPolicy: Account-level identity-access policy, which includes custom policies and system policies.
ResourceGroupLevelIdentityBasedPolicy: Resource group-level identity-access policy, which includes custom policies and system policies
PolicyType.description_zh:
引起无权限的策略类型，取值如下:
ControlPolicy ：管控策略。
SessionPolicy：临时Token额外添加的一个权限策略。
AssumeRolePolicy：RAM角色的授信策略。
AccountLevelIdentityBasedPolicy：账号授权范围的主体策略，包含自定义策略和系统策略。
ResourceGroupLevelIdentityBasedPolicy：资源组授权范围的主体策略，包含自定义策略和系统策略

Code.description_en: The API status code or POP error code

ActionInfo.description_en: The allowed operation information. When you use this parameter, the system matches the operation action based on the currentStepName and status in this information. If no action is matched, the current task status does not support the operation
ActionInfo.description_zh: 允许的操作信息，具体使用时是根据 currentStepName+status 在此信息中匹配操作 Action，如果未匹配到 Action，代表任务当前状态不支持操作

CallerSource.description_en: The ID of the requesting user. If callerSource is User, it represents the user UID
CallerSource.description_zh: 请求用户 ID，callerSource 为 User 时代表用户 UID

CallerUid.description_en:
The request source. Valid values:

System: System.

User: User
CallerUid.description_zh:
请求来源，取值说明：

System：系统。

User：用户

CurrentStepName.description_en: The name of the current step. If this parameter is empty, the task has not started
CurrentStepName.description_zh: 当前执行的步骤名，如果为空代表任务未开始

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the task. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

ReasonCode.description_en: The reason why the current task is initiated

RemainTime.description_en: The estimated remaining execution time. Unit: seconds
RemainTime.description_zh: 预估剩余执行时间，单位为秒（s）

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the task. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 任务开始时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Scheduled: Pending execution.

Running: Running.

Succeed: Succeeded.

Failed: Failed.

Cancelling: Being canceled.

Canceled: Canceled.

Waiting: Waiting for the scheduled time
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。

Scheduled：等待执行。

Running：执行中。

Succeed：执行成功。

Failed：执行失败。

Cancelling：正在终止。

Canceled：已终止。

Waiting：等待预设时间

Uid.description_en: The ID of the user to which the resource belongs

Message.description_en:
The additional information about the call result. Valid values:
If the request is normal, Success is returned. 
If the request is abnormal, a specific error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
调用结果的附加信息。取值说明：
请求正常，返回Success。 
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the query result

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功，取值说明：
true：成功。
false：失败
